title: Large Language Models as Subpopulation Representative Models: A Review

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting language models with partisan demographic data and comparing the simulated responses, voting behaviors, and moral rationalizations against ground-truth public opinion surveys (e.g., ANES) and psychological frameworks like Moral Foundations Theory.

Evaluating disparities in opinion prediction accuracy across different demographic groups, specifically comparing the model's fidelity and predictive performance for white and high-socioeconomic status demographics against marginalized or underrepresented demographics.

Analyzing generated consensus opinions and simulated subpopulation texts to identify the erasure of marginalized voices, the dominance of authoritative voices in data collection, and the propagation of social stereotypes.
